title: runs lists no drift for an item whose file is done on main and whose run state is none
goal: backlog.py runs prints a drift line for an item done on main whose run state is none, as for any state other than landed, and --reconcile writes landed and exits 0 once none is left

run:
import subprocess, tempfile, os, shutil, re, sys, json, glob
R = os.getcwd(); T = tempfile.mkdtemp(); S = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), 'c.sqlite')
env = dict(os.environ, KB_COORD_STORE=S)
def sh(*a): return subprocess.run(a, cwd=T, capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
g = lambda *a: sh('git', '-c', 'user.email=a@b', '-c', 'user.name=n', *a)
g('init', '-q', '.'); g('commit', '-q', '--allow-empty', '-m', 'init')
shutil.copy(R + '/backlog.json', T); os.makedirs(T + '/kb/_self/backlog')
bl = lambda *a: sh(sys.executable, R + '/_tools/backlog.py', '--root', T, *a)
def c(*a): return subprocess.run([sys.executable, R + '/_tools/coord.py', '--store', S, *a], capture_output=True, text=True)
sp = re.search(r'SP-\w+', bl('new', 'sprint', '--title', 'S', '--goal', 'g').stdout).group(0)
iid = re.search(r'ST-\w+', bl('new', 'story', '--title', 'Planted', '--goal', 'g', '--check', 'python3 -c pass').stdout).group(0)
for f in glob.glob(T + '/kb/_self/backlog/*.json'):
    d = json.load(open(f, encoding='utf-8'))
    if d['id'] == sp: d['status'] = 'active'
    if d['id'] == iid: d['status'] = 'done'; d['sprint'] = sp
    json.dump(d, open(f, 'w', encoding='utf-8'), indent=2)
g('add', '-A'); g('commit', '-q', '-m', 'planted done')
before = bl('runs', iid)
fix = bl('runs', iid, '--reconcile')
after = bl('runs', iid)
ok = before.returncode == 1 and 'drift' in before.stdout and fix.returncode == 0 and 'landed' in c('get', 'run/' + iid).stdout and after.returncode == 0
print('before', before.returncode, before.stdout.strip()[-100:], '| reconcile', fix.returncode, '| after', after.returncode)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

clauses.clause: backlog.py runs prints a drift line for an item done on main whose run state is none, as for any state other than landed
--reconcile writes landed and exits 0 once none is left

notes: Found by the SP-sucr3kfg review. bl_runs.drift_of returns no drift when the state is none, but none on a done item is what an unreachable coord at claim, dispatch or land leaves, the case --reconcile is for; the sprint's own ST-3ru7f4to, ST-pmxnissq, ST-vopsopkg and ST-fzczb63u show it. Decide whether an old done item with no run key is noise: a key-less item done before the run states existed would then be listed once. Planning 2026-10-24: premise ran on today's base: the repro prints 'runs: 1 item(s), 0 drifted' for a done item with run none (exit 0). Open question of the note taken as recommended: a done item with no run key is drift (git shows landed), listed once and repaired by --reconcile; the default scope of runs (the active sprints' items and items with a key) keeps the old done items out, and close deletes a sprint's items. drift_of keeps returning none for an item that is not done. Planned into SP-dx76osrn on 2026-10-24, eighth in the order. Sprint SP-dx76osrn started 2026-10-24 on the standing approval; ready once ST-34vqqkun is done.
